game.name: Wuthering Waves
game.notes: Version 3.7 'Prism's Illusion, Heart's Illumination' runs 2026-09-30 to 2026-11-12; 3.8 start on 2026-11-12 is an estimate, not officially announced. 3.7 events end 2026-11-11; trackers put the 3.8 start anywhere from Nov 10 to Nov 12.

events.title: Cubie Wars
events.summary: Version 3.7's headline Wooly Stage brawl event with unlockable Cubie Warriors and the patch's biggest Astrite payout.
events.description: Cubie Wars is a leisure event set on the Wooly Stage, where Cubie Warriors fight using magical items. Clearing stages and defeating new foes unlocks more warriors and opens up harder fights. Adventure Goals pay Stage Badges that unlock milestone rewards, while Stage clears also pay Show Coins redeemable at the Backstage Store. It is the highest-paying event of Version 3.7 and runs for the entire patch.
events.gameplay: Fight through stages with progressively unlocked Cubie Warriors, chasing Adventure Goals for Stage Badges and spending Show Coins in the Backstage Store. Completing the same-named 'Cubie Wars' quest first is recommended.

rewards.note: total across milestone track and Backstage Store

events.rewardsSummary: 1,200 Astrite + Showtime! sigil + Wooly's Blessing avatar + Premium Tuner + Bloom of Hearkening (material quantities unlisted)

events.title: Dreams in the Capsule
events.summary: Exploration event for the new Simulacrum Nexus area of Mengzhou: CSC Cipherlocks from tasks unlock a reward track totalling 500 Astrite.
events.description: Dreams in the Capsule explores the Simulacrum Nexus in Mengzhou across four phases that unlock as you progress the main quest. Tasks mix puzzles, combat, and item collection throughout the region, and rewards unlock based on how many CSC Cipherlocks you collect. Game8's task and milestone breakdown totals 500 Astrite — 280 from the sixteen phase tasks and 220 from the five CSC Cipherlock milestones — which resolves the earlier 500-vs-200 discrepancy in favor of 500. The event is effectively gated by story progress through Chapter IV Act IV.
events.gameplay: Complete puzzle, combat, and collection tasks in each of the four phases; CSC Cipherlocks earned from tasks advance the milestone reward track at 25/50/75/100/120 locks.
requirements: Meet the Nexus Fox Shadow in Mengxuan Vale during Main Quest 'Simulacrum of the Heart'

rewards.note: 280 from task rewards + 220 from CSC Cipherlock milestones per Game8 breakdown; the earlier 200 figure from WutheringPity is contradicted by the itemized tables

events.rewardsSummary: 500 Astrite (280 tasks + 220 Cipherlock milestones) + Forgery Advanced Supply x12 + Forgery Premium Supply x12 + potions/cores/tubes + Bloom of Hearkening x10 + Miasmic Branch x10 + low-grade task materials + 200,000 Shell Credit

events.title: Gifts of Waking Moon
events.summary: Seven-day login event handing out 5 Radiant Tides and 5 Lustrous Tides.
events.description: Gifts of Waking Moon is Version 3.7's seven-day login event running from the patch launch until November 11. Log in on any seven days (they do not need to be consecutive) and claim each day's reward directly from the event page. It pays direct pull currency — Radiant Tides for limited banners and Lustrous Tides for the standard banner. Rewards are claimed on the event page, not mailed.
events.gameplay: Open the event page on seven separate days during the event window and claim that day's login reward.

events.title: Waking Moon Fishing
events.summary: Fishing challenge at the Waking Moon Festival stall, paying 100 Astrite and Advanced materials via the Fishing Index.
events.description: Waking Moon Fishing is Version 3.7's browser event at a stall in the Waking Moon Festival. Fish to fill the Fishing Index — new Index entries are what pay the Astrite — and finish event tasks for the Advanced material rewards, which are sent to your in-game account. It runs 10:00 October 15 to 09:59 November 1 (UTC+8), so it closes the evening of October 31 in the Americas.
events.gameplay: Play the fishing challenge in the browser event, register new catches in the Fishing Index for Astrite, and complete the event tasks for materials.
events.rewardsSummary: 100 Astrite + Advanced Resonance Potion + Advanced Sealed Tube + Advanced Energy Core + Shell Credit (material quantities unlisted)

events.title: Back to Solaris
events.summary: Returning-player invitation web event paying inviter rewards up to 480 Astrite and 50 Astrite to each linked returnee.
events.description: Back to Solaris is Version 3.7's returning-player web event. Share your invitation code with up to three returning players on your own server and complete tasks together to collect Fox Fortune Sticks, which buy the inviter's rewards. Each returning player who links to an inviter claims their own reward bundle. The event stays open until 23:59 on November 11, later than the in-game events.
events.gameplay: Invite returning players with your code, complete joint tasks to earn Fox Fortune Sticks, and exchange sticks for rewards.
requirements: Invited players must be returning players on the same server

rewards.note: inviter total via Fox Fortune Sticks

events.rewardsSummary: Up to 480 Astrite (inviter) + 50 Astrite per returnee + Shell Credit + Advanced Enclosure Tank III (returnee)

events.title: Artisan's Search
events.summary: Multi-wave combat event across six Apprentice's Log domains, paying 500 Astrite plus premium materials and 580,000 Shell Credit.
events.description: Artisan's Search is Version 3.7's limited combat event, open October 8-26. Rovers battle multiple waves of enemies in six 'Apprentice's Log' domains, each with its own Domain Effect buffs and a trio of trial characters. Choosing a higher difficulty multiplies coins earned (1x/2x/4x); 25,000 coins per stage unlocks that stage's reward, and total accumulated coins up to 600,000 pay the main milestone track. Game8's stage and coin tables sum to exactly 500 Astrite. It closes at 03:59 on October 26, over two weeks before the version ends.
events.gameplay: Fight through multi-wave stages with trial or owned Resonators, stacking Domain Effects as waves clear; push coin multipliers via difficulty to hit the 25,000-per-stage and 600,000-total coin objectives.
requirements: Activate Four Chime Shaftpost in Main Quest 'The Wind Before the Storm'

rewards.note: 300 from six stage objectives (50 each) + 200 from accumulated-coin milestones per Game8 breakdown

rewards.item: Premium Enclosure Tank - Land of Xuanfang

events.rewardsSummary: 500 Astrite + Premium Tuner x100 + Premium Enclosure Tank - Land of Xuanfang x8 + Forgery Premium Supply x4 + Advanced/Premium potions, cores and tubes + 580,000 Shell Credit

events.title: 3.7 Moonlit Path
events.summary: Version 3.7 top-up spending event: earn Moonlit Rings from eligible purchases and claim milestone rewards up to a selectable 5-star Resonator.
events.description: Moonlit Path is Version 3.7's returning spending event. Eligible purchases marked for Moonlit Path during the version grant Moonlit Rings — 1 Ring per 10 Lunite topped up, plus fixed Ring amounts for marked event packs and the Lunite Subscription. The Ring ladder pays: Lustrous Tide x1 free; Radiant Tide x1 (30 Rings); Motorbike Accessory: Hsin Cube (88); Forging Tide x2 (198); Hsin Accessory: Where Dreams Shine Clear (328); 5-Star Weapon Supply Chest: Synth Armament (450); Transducer x3 (680); selectable 5-Star Resonator — Shorekeeper, Carlotta or Phoebe — or Transducer x8 (980); Version 3.7 Cosmetics Set (1,600); Cloudview Seat (2,200). Only purchases showing the Moonlit Path mark count — Battle Pass and unmarked packs grant nothing.
events.gameplay: Top up Lunites or buy marked event packs during Version 3.7 to collect Moonlit Rings, then claim milestone rewards from the event page as your Ring total grows.
requirements: Eligible in-game purchases marked for Moonlit Path during Version 3.7

rewards.note: free first milestone, no Rings needed
680 Moonlit Rings; x8 available as the 980-Ring alternative to the Resonator selector
980 Moonlit Rings; Resonators at max wavebands cannot be selected
450 Moonlit Rings; choose one standard Synth Armament series weapon

rewards.item: Version 3.7 Cosmetics Set (Avatar, Sigil, Custom Accessory)

rewards.note: 2,200 Moonlit Rings; equippable on the Utility Wheel

events.rewardsSummary: Moonlit Ring milestones: free Lustrous Tide x1, Radiant Tide x1 (30), Hsin Cube (88), Forging Tide x2 (198), Where Dreams Shine Clear (328), 5-Star Weapon Chest: Synth Armament (450), Transducer x3 (680), selectable 5-Star Resonator or Transducer x8 (980), v3.7 Cosmetics Set (1,600), Cloudview Seat (2,200)

events.title: Bountiful Crescendo
events.summary: Recurring one-week double-drop event: double leveling materials from Forgery and Simulation Challenges ahead of Phase 2.
events.description: Bountiful Crescendo is the recurring mid-patch double-drop event, running October 15-22 just before Phase 2 opens. During the window, claiming stage rewards from Forgery Challenges and Simulation Challenges with Waveplates pays double the usual leveling materials — Resonance Potions, Energy Cores, Shell Credits and forgery materials. It is a farming window rather than a reward track: there are no milestone rewards beyond the doubled drops.
events.gameplay: Spend Waveplates on Forgery Challenges and Simulation Challenges during the event window to receive double drops from each claim.
events.rewardsSummary: No fixed event rewards — double leveling-material drops from Forgery and Simulation Challenges (Resonance Potions, Energy Cores, Shell Credits)

events.title: Version 3.7 Phase 1 Convenes: As Full as Tonight, Forever (Hsin) / Horizon of Dawnbreak (Chisa) / Across Time's Waxes and Wanes (Iuno)
events.summary: Phase 1 featured banners: new 5-star Electro Rectifier Hsin plus Chisa and Iuno reruns, with their signature weapons.
events.description: Phase 1 of Version 3.7 runs three Featured Resonator Convenes simultaneously: 'As Full as Tonight, Forever' debuts Hsin (5-star Electro Rectifier, 'The Moon Fox'), alongside reruns 'Horizon of Dawnbreak' (Chisa) and 'Across Time's Waxes and Wanes' (Iuno). Featured 4-stars are Buling, Taoqi, and Youhu. The paired Featured Weapon Convenes are Blooming Jadehaven (Hsin), Kumokiri (Chisa), and Moongazer's Sigil (Iuno), where a 5-star drop is guaranteed to be the featured weapon. Banners close at 09:59 on October 22 as Phase 2 opens one minute later.
events.gameplay: Spend Radiant Tide (character) or Forging Tide (weapon) on pulls; 80-pull hard pity, 160 Astrite per pull on limited character banners.
events.rewardsSummary: No event rewards — gacha banner (160 Astrite per pull, 80-pull hard pity)

events.title: Version 3.7 Phase 2 Convenes: Nine Deaths, One Unbent Heart (Suoming) / Tomorrow in the Frame (Lucilla) / Undefined Spectrum (Lynae)
events.summary: Phase 2 featured banners: new 5-star Electro Sword Suoming plus Lucilla and Lynae reruns, with their signature weapons.
events.description: Phase 2 of Version 3.7 opens at 10:00 on October 22 with three Featured Resonator Convenes: 'Nine Deaths, One Unbent Heart' debuts Suoming (5-star Electro Sword), alongside 'Tomorrow in the Frame' (Lucilla's first rerun) and 'Undefined Spectrum' (Lynae's third rerun). Featured 4-stars are Lumi, Danjin, and Chixia. The paired Featured Weapon Convenes are Unspoken Rue (Suoming), Freeze Frame (Lucilla), and Spectrum Blaster (Lynae), with the featured weapon guaranteed on a 5-star drop. All six banners close at 11:59 on November 11.
events.gameplay: Spend Radiant Tide (character) or Forging Tide (weapon) on pulls; 80-pull hard pity, 160 Astrite per pull on limited character banners.
events.rewardsSummary: No event rewards — gacha banner (160 Astrite per pull, 80-pull hard pity)

events.title: Echo Erase
events.summary: Leisure puzzle event mixing echoes on a board to clear matches and recharge Resonator skills.
events.description: Echo Erase is a leisure puzzle event opening with Phase 2 on October 22. Players move echoes around a board to clear matching echoes, which recharges their Resonator's skills; new levels unlock daily across Normal and Hard difficulties. Clearing stages and reward tracks pays Astrite and premium materials. It closes at 03:59 on November 9, two days before the version's main deadline.
events.gameplay: Slide and match echoes on a puzzle board to clear matching lines and charge skill effects, working through daily stage releases on both difficulties.

events.title: Gifts of Singing Drizzle
events.summary: Phase 2 login event paying 10 Radiant Tides total plus 100 Premium Tuners and Crystal Solvents.
events.description: Gifts of Singing Drizzle is the Version 3.7 Phase 2 login event, opening at 10:00 on October 22 and closing at 03:59 on November 11. Cumulative login tiers pay Radiant Tide x5 with Premium Tuners at the 1-day tier and Radiant Tide x5 with Crystal Solvent at the 3-day tier — 10 Radiant Tide in total (Game8's guide text says a 4th login day wraps up the claims). It is direct pull currency aimed at the Phase 2 banners.
events.gameplay: Log in on the event's cumulative day tiers and claim rewards from the event page.

events.title: Beyond the Waves: Land of Xuanfang
events.summary: Tile-reveal board event: log in daily and complete tasks to win rewards across the Land of Xuanfang.
events.description: Beyond the Waves: Land of Xuanfang opens at 04:00 on October 29 and runs to the version's final deadline. Players earn Adventure Logs — 2 from logging in and 1 per 40 Waveplates spent, up to 10 per day — and spend them to reveal tiles on a board, winning random rewards from the revealed spaces. It pays 400 Astrite, a Lustrous Tide bundle, and premium materials. It is one of the last events to open in Version 3.7.
events.gameplay: Log in daily and spend Waveplates to earn Adventure Logs, then reveal tiles on the reward board and claim whatever the revealed tiles contain.

rewards.note: printed on the official content notice

events.title: Chord Cleansing
events.summary: Recurring Echo double-drop event: double Echo and Echo upgrade drops from Tacet Suppressions for the final week of 3.7.
events.description: Chord Cleansing is the recurring Echo double-drop event, running November 4-11 in the final week of Version 3.7. Complete Tacet Suppressions at the normal 60-Waveplate cost for double Echoes and Echo upgrade materials — three doubled claims per day, refreshing at 04:00 server time; the 120-Waveplate claim option is unavailable during bonus runs. Doubled: Echoes, Echo EXP items (Sealed Tubes), Tuners, Union EXP, Shell Credits and Intimacy. Not doubled: Astrite — field Astrite is a one-time first-clear bonus that never doubles.
events.gameplay: Run Tacet Suppression challenges and spend Waveplates to claim doubled Echo and Echo development drops, up to three times a day.
events.rewardsSummary: No fixed event rewards — double Echo and Echo upgrade drops from Tacet Suppressions (3 doubled claims per day; no bonus Astrite)

events.title: Wuthering Exploration: Fogveil Pagoda
events.summary: Version 3.6 exploration event at Fogveil Pagoda in Mengzhou, paying 800 Astrite plus premium materials.
events.description: Wuthering Exploration returned in Version 3.6 at the Fogveil Pagoda location in Mengzhou. Players explored the area completing event objectives for a reward track of Astrite and premium upgrade materials. It ran from September 17 until the day before the Version 3.7 maintenance. It was one of the last Version 3.6 events to close.
events.gameplay: Explore the Fogveil Pagoda area and complete exploration objectives to advance the event reward track.
events.rewardsSummary: 800 Astrite + Premium Sealed Tube + Premium Tuner

events.title: The Strings Remember
events.summary: Version 3.6 story event with a 400 Astrite reward track plus premium materials.
events.description: The Strings Remember was Version 3.6's limited story event, running from September 3 to September 21. It followed a narrative storyline with event quests and tasks. Clearing the event content paid 400 Astrite along with premium upgrade materials. It ended nine days before the 3.6 phase concluded.
events.gameplay: Play through the event's story quests and complete the accompanying tasks to claim the reward track.
events.rewardsSummary: 400 Astrite + Premium Resonance Potion + Premium Sealed Tube

events.title: Wuthering Waves Battle Rush
events.summary: Version 3.6 combat-themed web event with an Astrite reward pool listed at 2,000.
events.description: Wuthering Waves Battle Rush was a web event that ran for the first four weeks of Version 3.6, from the patch launch on August 20 to September 17. It featured combat-themed challenges tied to the version's content. Its listed Astrite payout was 2,000 — the largest single-event figure of the 3.6 window. It closed alongside the phase transition mid-September.
events.gameplay: Complete web-based combat challenges and missions during the event window to earn Astrite rewards.

rewards.note: as listed by WuWaBuild; may represent the full milestone pool rather than a guaranteed per-player total — unverified
